comment: The authors' own signing code, vendored as an ORACLE. Our checks are verified by grading traffic this file produces: if our grader fails traffic built by the people who wrote the specification, our grader is wrong. Apache 2.0, attributed in NOTICE.
source: kit/company/validate/jose.ts in the Personal Agent Protocol implementation kit
why_vendored: So the verification is hermetic and anyone can reproduce it. A test that silently skips when the kit is absent would be the vacuous pass this project exists to avoid.

jose.ts.used_as: an oracle: the suite mints conforming traffic with it and requires every check to pass

schema.ts.used_as: the authors' own JSON Schema validator, so our discovery document is judged by their code and not ours

poppy.schema.json.used_as: the schema their validator applies to a poppy.json
